Author: Solona
Name: Proteus
Description:
• Lets you use overlays — skin-tight gear, tattoos, scales and the like — as a regular Penumbra mod you can toggle on and off, recolour, bind to Glamourer designs and collections, and more.

• Overlays render two ways. Painted into your skin, except now your overlays are dyeable. Or as a second skin, which lets you use sphere maps, metalness and animated glow that skin materials can't do.

• Reshape any mod's models. Paint on your character to pull clothing clear of your body, push it in, smooth it, stretch it across a hollow, or paint where the wind sways it. Hair works too. Edits save into the mod and can be undone.

• Add on/off switches to any part of any mod.

• Make modded hair fit under hats, and undo it any time.

• Import regular old mods and equip them without using a gear slot.

• Save a mod's look as a preset you can wear, share and swap.

• Imports Penumbra .pmp, Onion .omp and Atramentum Luminis .ttmp2 glow tattoos, with no shader mod needed.

• Cloth overlays can enable skindenting with one click.

Type /proteus to manage your Proteus mods.
Punchline: Overlays, off-slot gear and model editing for Penumbra mods
Changelog:
New: Studio - reshape a garment right on your character.

The new Studio tab (the second tab) lets you fix a body poking through clothes
without leaving the game. Brush straight onto the character and watch the
garment change as you paint:

- Pull out and Push in move cloth away from or toward the skin.
- Relax smooths a lumpy patch; Bridge stretches cloth straight across a hollow
  such as a cleft.
- Move picks up one part of a garment and drags it with arrows, and can carry
  the cloth around it along.
- Wind paints how much the game's wind sways each part of a garment.
- Mirror left/right, lock parts you don't want touched, brush sizes down to
  1 mm, and Apply to other sizes to carry an edit onto the mod's other bodies.

Edits save into the mod on their own, Ctrl+Z undoes a stroke, and "Undo saved
changes" puts the original file back. Hair can be brushed too, and garments
from an imported content pack can be edited like any other.

New: reinforced toes for sheer stockings.

With a toe cap on, Advanced has a Reinforced toe checkbox and a Density slider.
Like real hosiery, the toe is knitted heavier than the leg, so it reads as a
darker panel with the toes still faintly showing through.

Changed: the second skin sits much closer to the body.

It used to float 1 mm off the skin and now sits at 0.05 mm, so tight clothing
and stockings follow the body far more closely.

Changed: "Overlay gen2/vanilla" replaces the Bodies dropdown.

It is a single checkbox, on by default. Bibo and gen3/Eve bodies are always
overlaid.

Improved: cleavage, buttocks and crotch smoothing.

"Span the cleavage" and the buttocks span now work on Rue+ and bodies with
shape keys turned on, no longer clip into large breasts, and no longer leave a
seam at the waist. The skin tucked under each breast is carried in a gentle
curve instead of a W. On Rue+, "smooth between the legs" lays the garment flat
across the crotch instead of following the skin into it. Changes to a body
mod or its options now take effect without toggling a Proteus mod.

Fixed: a bare band with a white rectangle over the hips on AB Body.

Fixed: skin showing through stockings behind the toe knuckles with a toe cap on.

Fixed: importing older (v3) content packs.

These failed every time, and an import could wipe a mod's name and groups if
Penumbra was still busy with the pack. Imports no longer freeze the game while
they wait on Penumbra.

Fixed: body smoothing taking over chest pieces from ordinary gear mods.

Fixed: chat noise. The toe cap, glow and debugging notices now go to the log
instead of chat.

Also: Skindent has moved to a new Effects section in the colour editor, and Proteus is
now licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later.

Author: Solona
Name: Camera Tools
Description:
• Presents FFXIV's camera to ReShade as an IGCS camera tool, which is what accumulation depth-of-field add-ons need in order to work. Nothing has ever provided one for FFXIV before.

• Works with iMMERSE Parallax DoF and Otis_Inf's IGCS Depth of Field, and with their panorama and multishot capture.

• Frame the shot however you already do — Group Pose, Cammy, Brio. The camera is only taken over while an add-on is stacking frames, and handed straight back afterwards, so this does not compete with anything else you use.

• Requires ReShade 6.4+ with add-on support, plus a compatible depth-of-field add-on.

Type /camtools to see whether an add-on is connected.
Punchline: Lets ReShade's accumulation depth-of-field add-ons drive the GPose camera.
